children: ), the global leader in Protective Communications®, today announced that it has repaid in full its unsecured term loan from Maran Partners Fund, LP. Genasys made the final payment of remaining principal and accrued interest on October 23, 2026.

Genasys originally borrowed $4.3 million from Maran Partners on June 9, 2026, and made a partial repayment when the loan was amended on September 14, 2026. With the October 23 payment, Genasys has no remaining obligations under the loan.

“The repayment of the unsecured term loan strengthens our balance sheet and permits us to focus our loan servicing efforts on our secured term loan, under which we made our first monthly amortization payment on October 1,” said Cassandra Monteon, Genasys’ Chief Financial Officer. “Repaying the unsecured loan in full is an important milestone. Looking ahead, we expect to repay the secured term loan on schedule and remain focused on disciplined execution and further strengthening our financial position.”
